messages:
sophia: Quick sync — final run-of-show and ops for the CloudMarket + OrionHW joint webinar on Wed 4/13. Need speaker confirmations, HW demo fallback, and giveaway shipping cutoffs. TL;DR: final slides by EOD Mon, test demo Tues, giveaways shipped by Wed morning. @ashley-marketing can you confirm prize list and shipping SLA?

ashley-marketing: Got it. Prize list below: 10x branded jackets, 30x 32GB USBs, 100x sticker packs + 5x hardware raffle units (Orion). I can get labels printed by Mon AM. Shipping cutoff -> drop to carrier Tue 5pm to hit Wed AM regional hubs. Promo assets ready, will share tweet copy. :rocket:

mike-eng: Heads up on the HW demo: the live 2-node infer bench spikes at ~400ms p95 in our lab under load. We should plan a fallback: recorded demo + live parameter change session. Can someone bring a spare NVMe image for quick swap?

kevin-orion: We can ship a spare preloaded node overnight to your SF office Tue evening. Also happy to do a short 10-min hardware deep-dive segment — will need HDMI passthrough plan if on-site. For customs: ship as "demo unit - educational" with invoice zeroed to avoid VAT where possible. I can send our export contact.

evan-ops: For the virtual lab option, we need 24h prior access to the Orion node for stress testing. Please add the test accounts to the shared doc. Also: VPN creds, allowed IPs, and a staging Zoom link. Run-of-show snippet below — pls review: 

```
18:50 - Host intro (5m)
18:55 - Product keynote (10m)
19:05 - CloudMarket marketplace flow + provisioning demo (8m)
19:13 - OrionHW live demo OR recorded fallback (12m)
19:25 - Joint Q&A + live parameter tweak (15m)
19:40 - Raffle + giveaways announcement (5m)
19:45 - Close
```

sophia: That run-of-show looks good. Action items: 1) @mike-eng prep recorded demo and a 5-min live tweak script, 2) @kevin-orion confirm spare node ETA and export contact, 3) @ashley-marketing finalize giveaway logistics and raffle mechanics, 4) @evan-ops create staging Zoom + test creds and post link in doc. I'll ping speakers for slide deadlines.

mike-eng: I'll record the full demo today and upload to the shared folder. Live tweak script: change batch_size, quant mode, and show latency delta. Will add a short troubleshooting checklist for swap.

kevin-orion: Spare node ETA Tue 7pm to SF office (tracking incoming). Export contact sent via DM. Also can supply branded dongles if we need extra prizes.

deploy-bot: Reminder — create Zoom webinar and calendar invite, add co-hosts sophia, kevin-orion, and mike-eng. Auto-registrations enabled.

ashley-marketing: Raffle plan: attendees who stay for Q&A get token to enter. We’ll randomize and announce winners live. Shipping form link: https://forms.giveaway.example/ccm-orion — please test. Promo copy I posted to #marketing-drops.

evan-ops: Note on firewall: if Orion uses port 6006 for the dashboard we need to whitelist for Zoom webinar hosts. Adding IP list to the doc. Also request: anyone demoing remote model weights, please scrub any PII.

sophia: Perfect. Last thing: can someone do a quick dry-run Wed 9am PT? If Tue test shows any instability we flip to recorded + live tweaks. I'll schedule dry-run and tag folks. Thanks all. :pray:
